description: How each write journey's screen reads before its write, after it, on a page that never loaded, and - where the journey's promise is that nothing changed - on the wrong outcome it exists to catch. A journey that claims the screen CHANGED must fail on the before page. A journey whose promise is that the screen did NOT change cannot be judged that way, because before and after read alike by design; it must instead fail on the wrong outcome. Both must fail on a page that never loaded. These renderings are the SPEC of what each assertion must tell apart; they are not evidence about the live page, which needs a browser.
